our_takes.our-take: The DBS Live Fresh Card is a solid choice for young working adults in Singapore who spend at least S$800 monthly. Score up to 6% cashback on shopping and transport, capped at S$50 and S$20 respectively. The 0.3% cashback on all other spend provides a small safety net. While the S$800 minimum spend may be challenging for some, the card's first-year fee waiver and compatibility with Apple/Samsung/Google Pay enhance its appeal. Consider if your spending habits align with the categories to maximize rewards.
our_takes.good-for:
* Young working adults who spend on shopping, transport and are able to meet the S$800 monthly spend.
* Individuals seeking cashback on daily commutes, public transport, and ride-hailing services to offset transportation costs.
* Shoppers who want to earn cashback on purchases across apparel, electronics, and home appliances with no cashback expiry.
our_takes.things-to-note:
* A S$196.20 annual fee applies after the first year; ensure rewards outweigh the cost, or consider cancelling.
* Paying late incurs a S$100 fee, which can negate any cashback earned, so always pay promptly.
* The 27.80% annual interest rate can make debt expensive; aim to pay your balance in full monthly.
